evidence.quote: We propose a $35 million class fund, distributed automatically to the members Brightline can identify from its records. The separate $3.5 million fee request remains subject to court approval
To bridge the remaining gap, we propose a $33 million class fund and accept your $2.5 million fee figure, subject to court approval.
We accept Brightline’s latest term sheet: a $30 million class fund distributed automatically, plus $2.5 million in court-approved fees

summary: Plaintiff counsel raised fees alongside class relief before the fund was agreed. Hargrove Lane later paired a higher proposed fund with acceptance of a lower fee figure, but the binding Whitcombe Reyes deal shows no fee-driven reduction in class recovery. The declaration accurately describes the negotiation sequence.
